test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

I had praying / to God / for your golden future.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "I had praying / to God / for your golden future." does not follow the proper grammar rules for verb usage.
 
• The past perfect tense auxiliary "had" is incorrectly used with the present participle "praying", making the sentence ungrammatical.
 
• Among the given options, option 2, "I had praying" is hence the part of the sentence that contains the error.
 
• The **correct sentence** will be: 'I had prayed to God for your golden future'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "No error" This option is incorrect as there is clearly an error in the verb usage in the sentence.
 
• Option 3: "to God" This part is not in error as 'to God' is a correct usage in this context.
 
• Option 4: "for your golden future" This part of the sentence is also grammatically correct and appropriately used in the given context.
